pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1080x1080 frame

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; cup and saucer pixel-identical position in all frames)
camera.background: uniform plain grey (~155 grey level), no ground line, horizon or markings
camera.perspective: orthographic-looking side view; 2D scene - one metres-per-pixel scale applies to everything

objects.name: cube
objects.description: small white cube with a slightly darker centre spot, falls straight down at x ~539.5 into the cup
objects.hidden_frames: 0-20 (above the top image edge), 46 (inside cup, behind cup wall)
objects.reference_point: centroid of the cube mask (= cube centre / origin)

size_px.note: bbox incl. ~1 px anti-aliased edge; solid core ~25 px. Mean bbox over frames 22-45: 26.0 x 26.9 (frames 38-40 26 x 26)

objects.motion: pure vertical fall (x constant 539.4-539.6 px); y increases every frame, frame-to-frame step grows from ~27 px (f22->23) to ~53 px (f44->45)

objects.name: cup
objects.description: white teacup standing on the saucer, handle on the LEFT side; rim at y=974
objects.note: frames 0-1 render the cup semi-transparent (cut-away look, inner cavity visible: inner wall roughly x 512-578, bottom y~1045); from frame 2 it is opaque. Cup outline identical.

objects.name: saucer
objects.description: white shallow saucer under the cup, lowest object in frame

events.event: cube first appears at top image edge (partly visible, bottom edge at y=11)
cube last visible, bottom edge at y=958, 16 px above cup rim
cube enters the cup (passes rim y=974, hidden by cup wall; small disturbance visible at rim)
release / start of fall: not visible (cube is already moving ~19-27 px/frame when it appears)
